name: cdn-node-operator
description: Bounded operator for auditing or configuring one registered Linux origin as one Cloudflare-fronted 3x-ui/Xray WebSocket node. One local stdio MCP server (cdn-node), closed 31-Tool catalog frozen by the Core-v1 contract. Phase 0-4 source build: contract, ledger, audit journey, clean-host install, broker credential flow, node journey with authenticated end-to-end verification, and the optional BBR branch exist in source and are exercised only against hermetic fake adapters in temporary data directories. Every production adapter stays phase-gated and fails closed before dispatch, so this build is not INSTALLABLE, not RUNNABLE against real infrastructure, and not ACCEPTED.
